name: Chair
dimensions: Height 104 cm; Height 50 cm; Length 60 cm
summary: This armchair has a straight back instead of a curved one. It is made of the expensive Huali wood, and it would have served as a dining chair. Another use it might have had is that of a 'meditation chair', a term often mentioned in 16th-century texts.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
